sentences.en: The little girl is not capable of riding a bicycle.
sentences.zh: 这个小女孩还不足以骑自行车。

sentences.en: Jimmy is to some extent capable of performing this operation.
sentences.zh: 吉米在某种程度上能够完成这项操作。

sentences.en: He isn't any more capable of it than I am.
sentences.zh: 他和我一样都不可能做到这件事。

senses.zh: 能干的,有才能的,有才华的,能胜任的n.有才能的，能干的

mnemonic: 词根记忆：cap（握住）+able（能…的）→能握得住的→有能力的
